failedAssertions.reason: The happy path could not be completed, Resend now stayed disabled after the cooldown, invalid-code UI feedback was missing, and Backspace did not clear the previous OTP digit.
Submitting reset-password surfaced the inline internal error "actor not found" instead of the expected reset-instructions success flash or normal user-facing error state.
Both upload flows created real builds, but each success state also surfaced an inline 'Cannot read properties of null (reading 'reset')' error after the upload completed.

One built artifact failed immediately with 'resource profile not ready yet', and the retry deployment dep_9173a9c71ba57387021b2015 remained stuck in status "starting" for repeated polls without a reachable runtime endpoint.
The log modal loaded, filtered, downloaded, and closed correctly, but Copy failed with 'Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied.' in the real browser session.

appliedUpdates.description: Documented that authenticated agent-browser sessions can become unreadable right after redirecting to /get-started even while localhost stays healthy; recover by restarting only the assigned browser daemon/session and reapplying auth via /api/v1/auth/session/exchange.

Documented that agent-browser may ignore requested download paths for exported log files; when that happens, move the file from %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp\playwright-artifacts-* into the assigned evidence directory and note the relocation in the flow report.
